findings.summary: The board-decision probe tests `message.get("kind") != DECISION_KIND` (work.decision.v1) instead of the repo's `DECISION_KINDS` tuple, so a `work.decision.v2` gate_release is never a wake fact. `supervise/decision_publisher.py:120` is the repo's single sanctioned decision publisher and it emits v2 with `refs[].target_entity == question_note_id` and a non-empty `decided_by` -- exactly the shape this probe looks for. `bus/board.py:30-34` states the rule in code ("识别「这是不是一条裁决」的读径一律用本元组，不点名单个版本"), and `Board.decision_for` (board.py:424), `state/fleet_state.py:431`, `goal_interrupt/bridge.py:255` and `design-e4b.md:19` all follow it. Not a spec violation -- 交付 1 and every 判据 name v1 verbatim -- and reachability is narrowed by the observer stripping DECISION_TOKEN_ENV from board_question units (`scheduler/supervisor_events.py:729`), so the live path is an operator-run supervisor holding the decision credential. Recommend widening to DECISION_KINDS in a follow-up.

The wake fires only on rulings strictly newer than `parked_at`, and `_establish_park` gives the board no equivalent of the inbox's "already has mail" pre-check, so a ruling landing between the blocked terminal and park establishment is never this probe's fact -- the line then depends on the inbox/goal.md sources. This is spec-mandated (阴性・时间向) and the window is normally one tick, but it is a real residual case worth naming.

Verification method disclosure: this reviewer has only file-inspection tools and no shell, so the prescribed `git diff --exit-code 0ea8ef97 96405231 -- . ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'` product-equality check was not executed. The review was performed against the checked-out worktree tree, whose only attempt-scoped artifacts outside the product tree sit under `.dev-dispatch/` (spec, handoff, feedback index, rc review); no product-file discrepancy was observed by inspection, and the deterministic seal independently verifies the actual Git HEAD.
